title: Monochromatic Portrait with Stylized Text
coreRelationships: The stylized portrait on the right is partially overlapped by the figure on the left, creating depth.
The large script text on the left figure's garment is a dominant visual element, contrasting sharply with the black fabric.
The high contrast between black and white/light gray defines all forms and creates a stark, graphic quality.
The brushstrokes and distressed textures add a raw, unrefined quality to the otherwise graphic composition.
reuseFormula: Recreate a high-contrast, monochromatic painting with a stylized portrait on the right and a larger, partially obscured figure on the left. The left figure's dark garment should feature prominent, distressed, custom script lettering in white. Maintain a raw, painterly aesthetic with visible brushstrokes and a stark black background. Include a small, light gray, hand-drawn signature in the bottom right.
